correctness.rationale: The two tetrahedra have volume 10/3 each. Exact Dirichlet height-density/ coarea integration gives the radial rational functions. Five vertex-height planes produce exactly 18 sectors. In each symbolic exact cancellation gives homogeneous coprime N,D with degrees (2,3), (3,4) or (4,5), and the 18 branches are pairwise rationally distinct (153 exact comparisons). The primitive homogenization D-10wN is absolutely irreducible and boundary patches are Zariski dense; no sign-wall component arises. Independently, 180 edge-intersection Euclidean hull areas and the exact vertical section verify normalizations. Finite numerical checks supplement, not replace, the all-direction analytic argument.

value.rationale: This is a complete, naturally motivated algebraic-boundary invariant of a canonical non-simplicial five-vertex 3-polytope. It exhibits three different nonlinear component degrees, in contrast with the known centered four-vertex tetrahedron split, and sharpens the broad six-degree upper bound to five for this eight-edge model. The exact number of components and degree 72 matter for understanding algebraic complexity of intersection bodies, beyond merely running a generic symbolic method. It makes no universal claim for translated or arbitrary five-vertex pyramids.
